    Alle Klassen und Schnittstellen

    Klasse
    Beschreibung
    ArrayDecoder
    Handles decoding of TOON arrays to JSON format.
    ArrayEncoder
    Handles encoding of JSON arrays to TOON format.
    Constants
    Constants used throughout the JToon encoding process.
    DecodeContext
    Deals with the main attributes used to decode TOON to JSON format.
    DecodeHelper
    Handles indentation, depth, conflicts, and validation for other decode classes.
    DecodeOptions
    Configuration options for decoding TOON format to Java objects.
    Delimiter
    Delimiter options for tabular array rows and inline primitive arrays.
    EncodeOptions
    Configuration options for encoding data to JToon format.
    Flatten
    Recursively flattens a JSON object or array into a single-level object.
    Flatten.FoldResult
    Represents the result of a key-folding operation.
    HeaderFormatter
    Formats headers for arrays and tables in TOON format.
    HeaderFormatter.HeaderConfig
    Configuration for header formatting.
    Headers
    Patterns in form of regex that must be followed in order to decode arrays, tabular, keyed arrays.
    Headers.KeyedHeaderMatch
    Result of Headers.matchKeyedArrayHeader(String) and Headers.matchKeylessKeyedHeader(String): the matched key, the structural positions of the header segments, and the declarations extracted from the bracket segment.
    JsonNormalizer
    Normalizes Java objects to Jackson JsonNode representation.
    JToon
    Main entry point for encoding and decoding TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) format.
    KeyDecoder
    Handles decoding of key values/arrays to JSON format.
    KeyedObjectDecoder
    Handles decoding of keyed tabular objects (§9.5) to JSON format.
    KeyedObjectEncoder
    Detects and encodes objects of uniform objects in keyed tabular form (§9.5).
    KeyFolding
    Enable key folding to collapse single-key wrapper chains.
    LineWriter
    Line writer that accumulates indented lines for building the final output.
    ListItemDecoder
    Handles decoding of TOON list item to JSON format.
    ListItemEncoder
    Handles encoding of objects as list items in non-uniform arrays.
    ObjectDecoder
    Handles decoding of TOON objects to JSON format.
    ObjectEncoder
    Handles encoding of JSON objects to TOON format.
    ObjectMapperSingleton
    Provides a singleton ObjectMapper instance.
    PathExpansion
    Path expansion mode for decoding dotted keys.
    PrimitiveDecoder
    Handles parsing of primitive TOON values with type inference.
    PrimitiveEncoder
    Encodes primitive values and object keys for TOON format.
    StringEscaper
    Handles string escaping for TOON format.
    StringValidator
    Validates strings for safe unquoted usage in TOON format.
    TabularArrayDecoder
    Handles decoding of tabular arrays to JSON format.
    TabularArrayEncoder
    Detects and encodes uniform arrays of objects in efficient tabular format.
    TabularField
    A field of a tabular header.
    ToonValidator
    Validates TOON-formatted strings for conformance to the TOON specification (§13.3).
    ToonValidator.ValidationResult
    Result of a validation run.
    ValueDecoder
    Main decoder for converting TOON-formatted strings to Java objects.
    ValueEncoder
    Core encoding orchestrator for converting JsonNode values to TOON format.
